findings.message: Tests version 2 of H-004, written after results, on windows already examined (2015-01-01..2019-12-31).
Positive Sharpe in fewer than half of the volatility regimes.
2 trials in 'short-term' were evaluated on their test window; out-of-sample p-values are Holm-adjusted for that.
H-004 was amended 1 time(s) after its first result (2025-02-03T09:00:21Z): v2 on 2025-02-05T11:00:00Z (The results show reversal, not continuation; restating the hypothesis.)
The predicted direction of H-004 changed: positive -> negative.
